videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video caption in Korean, around 500 characters, using only Korean (no English), and summarizing the key points in 3-5 sentences.

1. 6.3 local election early voting is on its second day
2. First day had highest early voting rate in local election history
3. As of 9 AM on second day, national early voting rate is 13.35%, higher than 11.81% at same time in previous 8th local election
4. Voting available at 3,500 locations nationwide (427 in Seoul) until 6 PM
5. Need photo ID (resident registration card, driver's license, passport) or mobile ID (app required, screenshots not accepted)
6. Different procedures for voting within district (put ballot directly in box) vs outside district (put in envelope then box)
7. Cannot take photos of ballots or damage them, cannot get replacement if mistake made
